title: 01 Create Flow
subtitle: Making a canvas and working on it — Studio site and Alligators brand
brief: zakladni user flow tvorby a praci s canvasem — the basic flow of creating and working on a canvas, drawn as edge cases on real projects (Maude/alligators with its complicated structure and many artboard kinds).

artboards.label: 1 · Home — one sentence
artboards.note: Home asks one question; the chip says which project the new canvas lands in.

artboards.label: 2 · AI drafts on a new canvas
artboards.note: Desktop is done; a dashed spark-coloured outline marks Tablet being drawn; a ghost shows where Mobile lands. Stop is one click.

artboards.label: 3 · Done — the result toast
artboards.note: The artboards land with a quiet “Made by AI” mark; with the AI chat panel folded, the result is a one-action toast.

artboards.label: 4 · Select — the inspector arrives
artboards.note: Selecting summons the inspector; the Canvases panel folds and the view slides left. Width 1280 typed → preset Custom.

artboards.label: 5 · A sticky and a comment
artboards.note: Annotating, so this is Preview: N switches to Preview with Sticky (its colours above it) and drops one for yourself; C pins a comment on the button that waits for an answer. The Share cluster reads Preview; esc returns to Edit.

artboards.label: 6 · AI went too far
artboards.note: AI's dark hero on Desktop — the before frame for the undo story.

artboards.label: 7 · ⌘Z undoes AI too
artboards.note: ⌘Z takes AI's change back; AI's edits sit in the same undo stack and in Version history.

artboards.label: 8 · ⌘N — a blank canvas
artboards.note: The online empty canvas from the DS empty-state specimen: Ask AI, or press F and draw.

artboards.label: 9 · F — a new artboard, any kind
artboards.note: F draws an artboard; the preset list groups web, social, print and video sizes.

artboards.label: 10 · Duplicate at another width
artboards.note: Right-click → Duplicate at another width › Laptop.

artboards.label: 11 · The copy lands in line
artboards.note: The Laptop copy lands under Desktop, left edges aligned, with the gap measured in the accent.

artboards.label: 12 · Frames and text in place
artboards.note: Double-click text to type in place; Layers shows the frames nested inside the artboard.

artboards.label: 13 · 93 canvases in folders
artboards.note: Folders whose counts add up to 93, recents, pictures, a truncated name with its tooltip, and the test files left as they are.

artboards.label: 14 · Search inside the panel
artboards.note: Typing flattens the tree; the match is marked, accent-insensitive, with the folder or matching artboard under each name.

artboards.label: 15 · ⌘K — canvases first, then tools
artboards.note: Search lists canvases with pictures first, then tools that aren't on screen with where they live, then Ask AI.

artboards.label: 16 · 21 artboards, fit to view
artboards.note: ⌘0 fits Combine-kampan's 21 artboards — 19 fixed-size social pieces and 2 print sheets — at 10 %; ⌘\ hides the panels.

artboards.label: 17 · Tereza, Jonas, AI and you
artboards.note: Each person on their own object in their own colour, AI's tag off the art, two AI chats open — with a legend. Modes are per person: Tereza writes on a sticky in her own Preview while you stay in Edit with Edit's toolbar.

artboards.label: 18 · Save status, in words
artboards.note: Saved · Syncing… · Offline — kept on this Mac · Local project — shown, never operated.

artboards.label: 19 · A canvas that won't draw
artboards.note: Plain-words error over the dimmed last good version; one verb, Go back to 14:05; AI's repair is a chip in its panel.

artboards.label: 20 · A new canvas with no internet
artboards.note: ⌘N works offline; Ask AI stays on, the prompt shows “Queued — sends when this Mac is online.” and the empty canvas adds “AI is back when this Mac is online.”
